data.name: Nitul
data.gender_notes: Nitul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nitul is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Nit’ which means ‘to bestow’ and ‘Ul’ meaning ‘mind’. This name signifies the one who bestows wisdom and knowledge. It is a name for a boy who is intelligent, wise and has a calm mind. The name Nitul carries the meaning “Lord of the mind” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nitul usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the mind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Nitul belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the mind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nitul total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
